function.name: design_rag_pipeline
function.description: Design a production-aware RAG pipeline architecture with ingestion, indexing, retrieval, generation, verification, observability, and safety controls.

problem_statement.description: The RAG system problem or use case to design for.

corpus_description.description: A short description of the document corpus, data sources, formats, volume, or domain.

requirements.description: Functional or non-functional requirements such as latency, citation quality, access control, freshness, or reliability.

constraints.description: Known implementation constraints such as budget, infrastructure, data privacy, indexing limits, or deployment restrictions.

function.name: verify_grounded_answer
function.description: Check whether an AI-generated answer has supporting evidence available and identify whether stronger claim-level verification is needed.

answer.description: The AI-generated answer that needs grounding verification.

evidence.description: Retrieved evidence passages, source snippets, or citation records used to support the answer.

claims.description: Optional extracted claims from the answer that should be checked against the evidence.

function.name: evaluate_ai_architecture
function.description: Review an AI system architecture for retrieval quality, grounding, tool safety, authorization boundaries, observability, evaluation coverage, cost, latency, and deployment readiness.

architecture_description.description: The AI system architecture, workflow, or design that should be reviewed.

review_focus.description: Specific areas to emphasize during the review, such as RAG, agents, security, observability, reliability, cost, or evaluation.

risk_level.description: The expected risk level of the AI system.

function.name: create_agent_observability_plan
function.description: Create an observability plan for an AI agent or assistant, including logs, metrics, traces, alerts, and failure signals.

system_description.description: A description of the AI assistant, agent, RAG pipeline, or tool-calling workflow.

runtime_components.description: Runtime components involved in the system, such as retriever, reranker, model, tools, verifier, database, queue, or API service.

risk_level.description: The expected operational risk level of the system.
